verdict: Original G1-G4 counterexamples are addressed in source; one new preparation-recovery ownership gap remains.

assessments.evidence: Public hireops_rules.md:363-368 now explicitly permits omitted claims, recomputation or safe refusal while preserving normal supported operation. Functional/prompt.md:39-41 restricts P5a to actually observed computed/session claims, distinguishes real editable inputs, uses eligible controls and fresh readback, and allocates outcomes to existing owners. Functional/judge.toml:587 ties the original clawback counterexample directly to hro_claw; other relevant formula/settlement/receipt/permission owners carry matching P5a clauses. A forged observed clawback that is settled can no longer meet this owned criterion. No guessed claim API or exact schema is added. The bounded protocol cannot certify unobserved private fields and does not claim to.

Functional/prompt.md:27 explicitly makes required operator financial figures readable in rendered screens/expandable details and allows response corroboration only. Functional/judge.toml:479,488,506 and641 add rendered grant units/start/schedule, remittance, referral recipient/date/halves and cliff. The original response-only app now fails its owned display checks. These fields are already required by public rules; equivalents, expansion and layout freedom remain permitted.

Polish/judge.toml:23 and50 explicitly require understandable visible refusal feedback for revision and coordinated commit recovery; Polish/prompt.md:12,14 agrees. Silent failure no longer satisfies the bars. Native validation and equivalent explanations are accepted, with no exact copy, budget number or shortfall wording imposed.

New hro_pol_change_prepare_recovery at Polish/judge.toml:36-41 explicitly observes refused Prepare, preserved selections/destinations/terms and correction. It accepts native validation and commit-time budget refusal, so the original clear-on-prepare app loses preparation credit. However the same row unnecessarily requires a successful commit both as an initial control and after correction; see NEW26-1.

source_refs: qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md: Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping
remaining_findings.evidence: The new prepare-stage criterion says establish a preview/commit control and then obtain a saved preview and successful commit, while claiming ownership of preparation-stage retention/correction independently of commit-refusal recovery. Successful Prepare is the matching control for refused Prepare; successful Commit is a different useful outcome.
remaining_findings.counterexample: An app has functioning source intake and durable previews, rejects an invalid Prepare with understandable feedback, retains all valid entered fields, and saves the corrected preview without re-entry, but its commit handler fails for an unrelated settlement defect. The complete preparation-recovery behavior loses its0.5 points solely because commit fails. Existing commit and retry criteria already own that failure.
remaining_findings.suggested_fix: Use a successful ordinary UI preparation as this row’s initial control and stop its corrected recovery at a saved valid preview; remove required commit success from this row and its prompt paragraph, preserving separate commit-recovery/retry bars.
remaining_findings.run_verdict: NOT EXERCISED; semantic counterexample, no score claimed

runtime_evidence_assessment.targeted_golden: Read driver, raw log and results. It observes a real409 Prepare refusal, visible explanation, retained fields, corrected preview/commit, and rendered financial fields. It uses API fixture setup and known reference routes. Its first preparation is the refused one, so it is useful finite product evidence rather than execution of the new exact control-first criterion or the configured judge.
runtime_evidence_assessment.partial_recovery: Read driver, raw log and results. It removes economic-version invalidation in a temporary copy, demonstrates improper ABA acceptance, then a genuine source refusal with retained fields and corrected successful operation. This supports recovery independence from economic-version enforcement. It does not test a broken-commit implementation with working preparation.
runtime_evidence_assessment.P5a: No hostile observed-computed-claim fixture is established by these two supplied drivers. G1 confirmation is a requirement-to-criterion source mapping, not measured hostile-claim execution.
runtime_evidence_assessment.unmeasured: No new Docker work was run by this reviewer. No full configured judge run, runtime budget, reward discrimination/ranking, Oracle or target-model result is established. Required official re-review and runtime gaps are not waived.
